results.title: A call in the session, with chips that light when someone talks
results.checks: Signed in, the host starts a session and its call (Start a call); a bar of chips shows over the reading with their own chip, microphone off. A second signed-in person opens the session's link, sees the call is running and joins it: each bar shows both people. The second person unmutes and talks (a test tone): their chip lights on the host's bar, and goes dark when they mute. The host ends the call for everyone and both bars go
results.note: Seed Reader and Alice Okoro in the call; Alice Okoro's chip lit while talking and went dark on mute; the host ended it
